expected_behavior: runs devmatrix.py with a named profile rather than hand-rolling wm size commands, and reports the per-cell status table
reports the dp bucket it VERIFIED from dumpsys (cur=WxH and swNNNdp read back after applying), not just the px/dpi arithmetic it intended
states the wm-size fidelity caveat — no display cutout, no real device aspect ratio or hinge, so a pass here is weaker evidence than a pass on a real device or a purpose-built AVD
restores the device configuration afterwards and says so

cases.prompt: does the app fail gracefully if there is no camera
expected_behavior: distinguishes what is testable at runtime on a stock emulator (permission revoke, appops deny, connectivity off) from what needs a differently configured AVD (hw.camera.back=none actually changes pm list features)
does not claim to have removed a hardware feature it cannot remove, and emits the AVD recipe instead when that is what the check requires
derives which capabilities matter from the APK manifest uses-feature/uses-permission (required vs optional) rather than testing a generic list

cases.prompt: sweep the matrix and fail the build if anything breaks
expected_behavior: separates HARD failures (crash or ANR attributable to the package during the cell, process death, activity not resumed) from SUSPECTED signals (blank screen, clipped or off-screen controls) and only gates on the former
exits non-zero when a hard failure is present
tags every finding with an evidenceType consistent with android-ux-audit rather than inventing a second severity vocabulary

cases.prompt: the last matrix run crashed halfway, is my emulator still messed up
expected_behavior: uses the restore/doctor path against the serial-keyed state file rather than guessing which settings were changed
knows that some resets are not restores — an appops mode whose original value was 'foreground' is not restored by setting it to 'default', and wm size/density need explicit reset
reports what it restored and what it could not

cases.prompt: check the app at the largest font size and in dark mode
expected_behavior: applies font_scale and uimode night as matrix cells and captures evidence per cell
hands the per-cell snapshot to android-ux-audit for the touch-target and unlabelled-control checks instead of re-implementing them
looks for truncated or clipped text at the large font scale and reports it as a suspected finding needing a human look
